items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: They had Isidore Fritz, Louis Fritz, his brother playing trombone, his daddy playing bass, old man Joe Fritz.

ctx.x: Oh Bunk played with that band.
Yeah that band. That's the band. They had a fine band. They had Isidore Fritz, Louis Fritz, his brother playing trombone, his daddy playing bass, old man Joe Fritz.
He had a bunk playing trumpet and this boy Leon Loron was playing guitar with him.
